subject: How to prepare data for analysis

messages.author: 69a6261b5b16f81f
messages.subject: How to prepare data for analysis
parts:
Hi there,

I am absolutely a beginner in using SEM in my research. I have tried to contact a few statisticians to help me, but no one was able.

I have one single option to analyze and submit my Ph.D. thesis pilot study very soon- doing it myself via the support of SEMNET communities.

Thus, I have entered my data into SPSS, and proposed to use either Amos or R (lavaan) for my analysis. I have one latent variable with three indicants and three dependent variables. I used predesigned survey questions to collect data for all six variables.

What very first step am I supposed to do particularly in using lavaan for my analysis? How can I prepare the data for convenient analysis?

Thank you

messages.author: ee65f9feb643484e
messages.subject: Re: How to prepare data for analysis
parts:
Hi Tariku, a good start would be to read the lavaan tutorial: http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/index.html

If you decide to use lavaan, save your data from SPSS to a text file, then read the text file into R. If you haven't used R before, you will probably need an introductory R tutorial. There are many of these available online.
